items.title: M0: Review scope and source inventory recorded
items.context: Plan M0.a-M0.e: confirm the canonical Proofbound root via lattice session_brief; inventory milestone ledger/status command surfaces via rg; inventory source docs and existing tests/smokes; record stale or retired-root documents that must not drive implementation truth. Output: trusted source map section in the findings report.

happy.desc: rg for ## M0 or Source Inventory section in milestone-ledger-status-review-findings.md -> section exists with at least one source file ref; WHY: confirms the inventory was actually recorded
rg session_brief or canonical root in findings report -> confirms canonical Proofbound root was verified not retired Orchestrate root; WHY: M0.a requires root confirmation
rg milestone_ledger_set|milestone_ledger_add|milestone_status|milestone_closeout in findings report -> all 5 command surfaces inventoried; WHY: M0.b requires complete surface inventory

edge.desc: rg stale|retired in findings report M0 section -> stale/retired-root docs explicitly called out or marked not-applicable; WHY: M0.e requires recording stale docs that must not drive implementation truth

adversarial.desc: Check findings report M0 section does not reference any path under the retired Orchestrate root /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate as authoritative -> no retired-root path treated as truth; WHY: prevents stale-root contamination of the audit

items.title: M1: Read-only status boundary review completed
items.context: Plan M1.a-M1.f: check allowed argument keys for milestone_status; verify unexpected keys fail before story reads; verify missing ledger produces a report not a write; verify status output launches no commands or reviewers, writes no evidence or lifecycle facts, and never claims DONE or production readiness. Output: boundary finding or pass.

happy.desc: Run npx lattice milestone_status --storyId=B-b550 -> output contains Mode: read-only and produces status table without errors; WHY: confirms milestone_status is a functioning read-only observer

rg for ## M1 or Read-Only Boundary section in findings report -> section exists with finding-or-pass verdict for each M1.a-M1.f sub-objective; WHY: confirms the boundary review was completed and recorded

edge.desc: Run npx lattice milestone_status with an unexpected key e.g. --writeEvidence=true -> CLI rejects with an error before any story read; WHY: M1.b verifies unexpected keys are rejected early

Verify evidence file m1-unexpected-key-rejection.txt exists under .lattice/story/actives/B-b550/evidence/ and contains rejection output; WHY: confirms live CLI probe evidence was captured for the rejection boundary

adversarial.desc: rg for DONE|production.ready|Authority in milestone_status output from evidence files -> status output never claims DONE or production readiness; WHY: M1.f verifies no overclaim in status output
Verify evidence file m1-mutation-flag-rejection.txt exists and shows z.never mutation flag was rejected; WHY: confirms the never-mutate safety boundary was probed and holds

items.title: M2: Ledger write contract review completed
items.context: Plan M2.a-M2.f: review milestone_ledger_set and milestone_ledger_add lifecycle phase policy and ownership classification; review ledger hash and candidate/confirmed state behavior; review whether direct writes can accidentally become confirmed gate evidence or silently overwrite existing rows unsafely. Output: write-surface finding or pass.

happy.desc: rg for ## M2 or Write Contract section in findings report -> section exists with finding-or-pass verdict covering M2.a-M2.f; WHY: confirms the write contract review was completed
rg lifecycle.phase.policy|phase.gate|DEV|PLAN in findings report M2 section -> lifecycle phase restrictions for ledger_set and ledger_add are documented; WHY: M2.a/M2.b require phase policy review

edge.desc: rg candidate|confirmed in findings report M2 section -> candidate vs confirmed state behavior documented; WHY: M2.d requires review of ledger hash and state transitions
Verify evidence file m2-confirmed-binding.txt exists and documents the confirmed-binding behavior; WHY: confirms live evidence of the confirmed state behavior was captured

adversarial.desc: rg for accidental.*confirm|silently.*overwrite|gate.evidence in findings report M2 section -> report explicitly addresses whether writes can accidentally become confirmed gate evidence or silently overwrite; WHY: M2.e/M2.f are the adversarial safety boundaries of the write contract

Check findings report M2 section does not contain pass verdict without addressing all 6 sub-objectives M2.a-M2.f -> no sub-objective silently skipped; WHY: prevents incomplete review from being marked clean

items.title: M3: Missing-ledger policy review completed
items.context: Plan M3.a-M3.f: review ordinary single-outcome story behavior with no ledger; review structural/semantic milestone trigger behavior; review candidate versus confirmed requirements; review DEV admission and REVIEW/DONE behavior for missing or stale milestone facts; verify missing-ledger next actions are specific and non-mutating. Output: missing-state matrix.

happy.desc: rg for ## M3 or Missing-Ledger Policy section in findings report -> section exists with a missing-state matrix or equivalent structured breakdown; WHY: confirms the policy review produced the required output artifact

rg ordinary|single.outcome in findings report M3 section -> ordinary single-outcome story behavior without a ledger is explicitly reviewed; WHY: M3.a requires confirmation that ordinary stories are not retroactively broken

edge.desc: rg DEV.admission|REVIEW|DONE in findings report M3 section -> lifecycle phase behavior for missing/stale milestone facts is documented; WHY: M3.d/M3.e require review of phase-specific gating behavior
Verify evidence file m3-dev-admission-enforce-block.txt exists and shows DEV admission enforcement behavior; WHY: confirms live CLI probe of the missing-ledger gate was captured

adversarial.desc: rg non.mutating|specific|next.action in findings report M3 section -> missing-ledger next actions are verified as specific and non-mutating; WHY: M3.f prevents status reports from recommending mutation as a fix for missing state

Check findings report M3 section addresses candidate vs confirmed requirements separately -> not collapsed into a single verdict; WHY: M3.c requires distinguishing candidate from confirmed which have different safety implications

items.title: M4: Schema and progress-model review completed
items.context: Plan M4.a-M4.f: review required milestone fields (id, source requirement, claim, doneMeans, required evidence); review checklist and verification-intent binding fields; review status values for progress tables; review parent/assigned-child story support; check prose-only text cannot produce hidden milestone claims; identify schema additions needed. Output: schema adequacy finding.

items.title: M5: Test and negative-control review completed
items.context: Plan M5.a-M5.f: find tests for milestone_status read-only behavior, missing-ledger reports, ledger set/add/get schema, milestone-triggered missing-ledger gates, and proof that milestone status cannot satisfy DONE by itself; record missing negative controls as review findings. Output: test-gap list.

items.title: M6: Agent capability impact review completed
items.context: Plan M6.a-M6.d: confirm structured milestone rows improve progress reporting, missing-ledger gates improve unattended execution safety, ledger refs improve host handoff continuity, and capability claims stop short of lifecycle DONE or Authority claims. Output: capability claim boundary.

items.title: M7: Review outcome recorded and next story decided
items.context: Plan M7.a-M7.d: summarize all pass/finding outcomes; decide whether implementation work is needed; if gaps exist draft a narrow follow-up story scope, otherwise mark documentation-only completion; update the plan document milestone statuses from planned to reviewed outcomes. Output: findings report closure section.
